name: namuk-process
description: Turn user intent into verifiable requests, apply consistent codebase design, and check results against completion criteria.

interface.shortDescription: Connect intent, design, implementation, and verification.
interface.longDescription: Clarifies intent and completion criteria, selects only the needed request checks, applies codebase-design during design and implementation, and verifies actual results against the original criteria.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use development-workflow to understand my intent and completion criteria, select the needed request checks, design and implement with codebase-design, and verify the results against those criteria.
